description: Build secure business apps that share users and data - no coding required.

interface.longDescription: Build business apps that are ready for your team from day one. Describe what you need in plain English and QI helps you plan, build, test and publish it from ChatGPT. Every app starts with a proven design and structure, plus secure sign-in, centrally managed users, teams and permissions. Your apps can share contacts, organisations, locations and assets, so they work together without duplicating data. Your ChatGPT subscription powers the build, with no separate AI build credits to buy.
defaultPrompt: Turn our measurement spreadsheets into an app for any device, with built-in calculations and saved, searchable results.
Build a facilities app to report issues, assign jobs, log engineers’ time and mileage, and track quality checks.
Replace paper vehicle checks with a mobile app where drivers submit checks and photos, and managers track defects and repairs.
